messages.msg: Lecture 3 logs a React element and names only type and props. Verified in React 19.3.1: the logged object also has $$typeof (Symbol(react.transitional.element)), key, _owner, and _store. Lecture 3 does not explain these fields; please explain them, and you may reuse Lecture 3's logged headline (the h2 with className headline and the text City Library Extends Its Hours) as the starting example.
